## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Tech and Financials are weak 1W while Utilities, Communication, Healthcare, Energy and Materials show 1W strength — two confirmations supporting rotation away from mega-cap Tech/Financial leadership; Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND; Communication strong: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND; Healthcare up: JNJ (1W: +2.99% | 1M: +9.67%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND; Financials lagging: BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Discretionary soft: TSLA (1W: -2.26% | 1M: -6.71%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND; CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND; PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY; INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY; NEM (1W: +6.44% | 1M: -1.48%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND; COF (1W: -6.13% | 1M: -10.08%) BELOW TREND; IBM (1W: -6.59% | 1M: -17.87%) BELOW TREND; NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND; GS (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Financials (3/5 in bottom five).

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest 1W moves: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY. Major divergence present: several top movers are RECOVERY (1W up, 1M down) — treat as tactical momentum, not confirmation of broad regime change.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology remains weak 1W and 1M: NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -18.27%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +3.11%) CORRECTION; sector 1W: -0.72% | 1M: -9.60% (24 stocks) — watch for further dispersion between recovery names (INTU, CRM) and large-cap weakness.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are under pressure 1W: BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -0.16%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W: -3.49% | 1M: -3.72% (20 stocks) — confirmatory signal for rotation away from banks.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare showing resilience: JNJ (1W: +2.99% | 1M: +9.67%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.75% | 1M: +6.92%) ABOVE TREND; sector 1W: +2.24% | 1M: +5.24% (17 stocks) — defensive and earnings-driven strength.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to sectors showing 1W strength — Utilities, Energy, Materials and Healthcare (example names: CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND; XOM (1W: +3.54% | 1M: +11.58%) ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to weak Financials and large-cap Tech (example names: BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND; NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND). Style: leaning Value/Cyclical rotation but with mixed signals — stay selective.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: JPM (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -0.16%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -8.17% | 1M: -7.02%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Utilities and Communication (1W strength; e.g., CEG and NFLX) with sector breadth supporting continued rotation. BEARISH: Financials and Technology where multiple large names are BELOW TREND and news flow is negative.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND — watch breach of this week’s lows for continuation risk. AAPL (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +3.11%) CORRECTION — monitor 1M pivot resilience for re-acceleration. JPM (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -0.16%) BELOW TREND — watch for follow-through on negative headlines as trigger for broader Financials pressure.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+80): Eli Lilly’s GLP‑1/Olumiant update; price confirming strength — LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND. PFE (+80): BRAFTOVI approval; price confirming — PFE (1W: +3.75% | 1M: +6.92%) ABOVE TREND. FCX (+80): Grasberg operating rights extension; price confirming — FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND. INTU (+60): strong earnings/AI push; price RECOVERY — INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY (watch for follow-through).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
JPM (-60): CLO/AI risk headline and price below trend — JPM (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -0.16%) BELOW TREND (sentiment and price confirm). WFC (-55): negative headlines and heavy selling — WFC (1W: -8.17% | 1M: -7.02%) BELOW TREND (confirmed). CRM (-50): PT cut but 1W strength — CRM (1W: +5.20% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY (diverging; watch for distribution).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION, lean toward Value/Cyclical style as Energy, Materials and Utilities show relative strength. NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +2.99% | 1M: +9.67%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +3.54% | 1M: +11.58%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk: major divergence with several RECOVERY names (INTU, CRM, PYPL) and negative Financials headlines (JPM) — watch for trend breaks before adding to core exposure.
